parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English. This is the default value.

parameters.name: AddressPoolName
parameters.description: The name of the address pool.

parameters.name: AddressPoolType
parameters.description:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

- IPv4: The address pool contains IPv4 addresses.

- IPv6: The address pool contains IPv6 addresses.

- domain: The address pool contains domain names.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the address pool. Valid values:

- enable: The address pool is enabled.

- disable: The address pool is disabled.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remarks for the address pool.
